title: A not-yet item whose posting window ended before setup still counts as expected until it is seen or the person says it will not come (decision Z2)
story: Set up Tue 22 Jun 2027 at 09:00. The bank holds 200,000, of which 30,000 is what is left of Free to spend (typed). The insurance of 30,000 was due Tue 8 Jun and tips of 20,000 were due to come in that day; both posting windows ended Wed 9 Jun, but the person says neither has gone through, so the opening saves both in `not_yet`. Pay of 250,000 on the 25th (moved earlier) starts the period. At the check-in on Thu 24 Jun at 20:00 the person ticks the insurance as paid on Wed 23 Jun and says the tips will not come (a skip). Every amount is made up.

events.note: ticked at the check-in: paid Wed 23 Jun
the person says the tips will not come

asks.question: safe_to_spend
asks.why: 200,000 (Bank today) - 30,000 (Insurance 8 Jun, not gone out at setup: still expected, taken off) = 170,000; the tips of 20,000 (8 Jun, not come in at setup) are still expected but not counted until ticked [BH1]
asks.note: BH1: money not yet seen never counts toward safe to spend. Under Z2 alone the tips counted: 190,000.

asks.question: not_seen_yet
asks.note: Both are still expected, not "not seen yet" [Z2].

asks.question: safe_to_spend
asks.why: 170,000 (Bank today; the insurance is seen and the tips will not come, so nothing of either is still expected) = 170,000
